description: This file defines a Perl module for handling the 'RecipeOfTheDay' result set in a database schema, including a method to retrieve recipes for the current day with optional random selection.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::ResultSet::RecipeOfTheDay
classes.description: A result set class for managing 'RecipeOfTheDay' entries, providing methods to retrieve today's recipes with optional random selection.

methods.name: today
methods.description: Retrieves all 'RecipeOfTheDay' objects for today, optionally selecting up to 'n' recipes at random, with the linked 'Recipe' always prefetched.
